version_scope: custom five-class mirror-derived remediation; NOT an authenticated copy of original agreed archive
original_archive_access: 403 in original audit; not retried in remediation; equivalence unverified
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; inherited primary license evidence, no additional permissions inferred
group_edges: Transitive connected components across all original rows: identical nonempty keys + 81 visually confirmed duplicate/asset-variant candidate edges. Quarantine applied after grouping.
normalized_text_rule: HTML unescape; Unicode NFKC; casefold; strip URL, leading RT mention prefix and all @mentions; join Unicode word tokens. Identical model-input text is conservatively grouped, not necessarily a duplicated source post.
filtered_original_rule: Exclude quarantine; for each base component retain only original rows from highest-priority eligible split test > dev > train. Do not move records or relabel. No seed needed.
secondary_guard_policy: Additionally union all 164 pHash<=4 candidate edges inside an original split (25 already connected,139 newly constraining). These were not individually visually adjudicated and may merge distinct graphics; they are conservative isolation guards ONLY for secondary repartition.

secondary_partition.algorithm: rare/large-first greedy normalized class/size objective, deterministic SHA256 seed ties; up to 8 single-component improvement passes

leakage_scope: Zero observed cross-split identity or declared must-link leakage under cached exact/normalized hashes, tweet entities and reviewed/guarded pHash candidates. No claim to detect all semantic, cropped, or pHash>4 duplicates.
data_and_training: No data downloads, relabels, training, proposal, repository or website writes.
inherited_checks: Original image decode, image-content hashes, pair/source joins and pair lengths reused; normalization and new split/content invariants checked here.
